newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones wins all shareholder votes.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones wins all shareholder votes.

text.p: Dow Jones & Co Inc on Wednesday safely secured the re-election of a group of directors and won backing for a management incentive plan at the annual shareholders meeting.

A shareholder proposal to subject management to objective performance criteria was defeated with 11.4 percent voting in favor, 88 percent against and the balance abstaining, a Dow Jones spokesman said.
He said the directors up for re-election and a group of new directors were approved by "a comfortable margin."
The three new independent directors are Frank Newman, chief executive of Bankers Trust Co, American Express Co CEO Harvey Golub and William Steere, chairman and chief executive of Pfizer Inc.
The company's proposal for a management incentive plan was approved with 97 percent voting in favor and three percent against, the spokesman said.
